name: Supported Living Payment
description: Main benefit providing financial assistance to clients with permanent and severe health conditions, injuries or disabilities, or those caring full-time for a person requiring full-time care and attention.

attributes.summary: Main benefit for people with permanent and severe health conditions, injuries or disabilities, or those caring full-time for such a person. Covers eligibility, obligations, payment, income, reviews and changes in circumstances.
attributes.eligibility: Age, residence, medical qualifications (health condition, injury or disability or caring for a person), immigration status. Medical pathways include existing assessments, medical certificates, NASC assessment, special education assessment, ORS assessment, and Work Ability Assessment.
attributes.payment_details: Main benefit with various income treatment provisions including charging income, personal earnings exemptions, exemption for severe disablement, blind clients subsidy, and earnings-related compensation. Absence provisions allow up to 28 days general; approved reasons for longer absences.
attributes.obligations: Work or work preparation obligations, social obligations, drug test obligations, work with contracted service provider obligation, work ability assessment obligation, and youth activity obligations. Non-financial sanctions include money management, community work experience, report job search, and upskilling.
attributes.stand_down: Initial stand-down and 28-day rule applicable. Non-entitlement period of 13 weeks for voluntary unemployment or misconduct or grade 3 sanction.
attributes.income_test: Charging income applies with personal earnings exemptions, exemption for severe disablement, blind clients subsidy, and earnings-related compensation.
